title: General Material Blend 3-Mix Trio #18 (대각 띠·물결 / 가로 띠·물결 / 동심원·매끈 | 뱀비늘+스테인드글라스+이레즈미 / 뱀비늘+목재+공작눈무늬 / 스테인드글라스+금박+석재)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Swedish, in her mid 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 50 studs piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold a necklace. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 29% of the way down her figure from the top and about 74% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING WARM BRONZE scale formations, VIVID BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, lotus pond formations in VIVID PINK and DEEP EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Pakistani, in her late 30s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
